unit_of_analysis: one frozen logical schedule; retries remain within the same schedule and are never an independent N

primary_endpoint.name: forbidden_commit_observed
primary_endpoint.definition: A transition committed only when the final observer proves the relevant persisted governance mutation committed before transition admission began.
primary_endpoint.denominator_rule: Only executed, observer-complete frozen schedules enter a denominator; NOT_RUN, infrastructure error, missing audit, and indeterminate ordering remain separate categories and never enter the denominator.
primary_endpoint.reporting: rate of observer-complete schedules with forbidden_commit_observed=true over the executed, observer-complete denominator, with a Wilson-score upper confidence bound (alpha 0.05).
primary_endpoint.zero_event_interval: When zero forbidden commits are observed, report the Wilson upper bound for a zero-event interval; an empty observation is never reported as a zero-finding.
primary_endpoint.indeterminate_rule: INDETERMINATE is never counted as safe, never counted in the numerator, and never recoded as a zero forbidden-commit observation.

rejection_auditability.definition: A rejected governance commit is auditable when the rejection decision event, reason code, proposal/snapshot coordinates, and zero state-transition rows are all present.
rejection_auditability.reporting: proportion of rejected schedules that are observer-complete with full rejection_auditability; missing any field marks the schedule incomplete, not a safety outcome.

committed_reconstructability.definition: A committed transition is reconstructable when the transition exists, the resulting state version is captured, the snapshot linkage is exact, and reconstruction succeeds.
committed_reconstructability.reporting: proportion of committed schedules with full committed_reconstructability; an empty or hash-only reconstruction is not completeness.

false_stale_burden.definition: Valid independent writes that were rejected only because of a state/coordination coordinate they legitimately did not depend on.
false_stale_burden.reporting: count and proportion over the executed denominator; a false stale rejection is recorded as burden, never as a safety failure of the rejected writer.

latency.definition: Per-schedule descriptive wall latency in milliseconds from setup through final observation.
latency.reporting: report p50, p95, and p99 across executed schedules; never infer deployment throughput from these latencies.

operational_rule: Deadlock/serialization outcomes (deadlock_detected, could_not_serialize_access, lock_wait_timeout) are operational outcomes, never safety success, and are reported separately from safety classifications.
missing_data_rule: Missing work is NOT_RUN and is never encoded as zero forbidden commits or a successful schedule.
freeze_rule: This plan, the frozen twelve-schedule v2 protocol, ordered synthetic seeds, environment metadata, and the v2 observer contract are frozen before execution; any material change requires a new run ID.
result_status_rule: A final result is claim-eligible only when every scheduled execution is observer-complete and every observed classification matches the frozen expected classification. NOT_RUN, infrastructure error, missing audit, indeterminate ordering, and expected/observed classification mismatches remain explicit and are never recoded as safe.
